Handed to the team · RMA not approved and the label service is refusing on an inactive subscription,

Hi Steven,

Fair question, and I owe you a straight answer rather than another "it's with the team".

I tried to buy your return label myself just now. It would not go through: the account we buy prepaid return labels on is blocked on our side, which is exactly why five requests have produced nothing. That is a billing problem of ours, not anything to do with your unit or your paperwork.

Here is where it stands. Your return is set up as Shop····, going to our Chattanooga, TN warehouse, and that reference is yours. The label has to be bought by hand by Abel or Georges, and that is in front of them as the first thing Monday at 10am ET, with your address, your phone number and this whole history. It comes to this email, and I've asked for a text to (phone hidden) when it goes out.

Please keep the NerdOctaxe boxed as it is and do not ship it at your own cost. Write Shop···· on the outside of the box when the label arrives.

I'm sorry it has taken this long for one label.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
God is good .. thank you so much.

Hi Steven,

Thank you for being patient with it, that means a lot after the run you have had.

Nothing more for you to do this weekend. Leave the NerdOctaxe boxed as it is, and watch for the label in this inbox from Monday morning, with a text to your cell when it goes out. Once you drop it off, I will keep an eye on it from this end and let you know when it reaches the warehouse and when your replacement unit is released.

If anything is still quiet, just hit reply on this thread and it comes straight to me.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you so much for the RMA … item will go to the USPS (MONDAY am)

I have made a decision to get the BITFORTUN BS-4 (18 TH/s)

Please let me know how to pay difference … will use Same Credit Card as original purchase .. if you need the number’s ETC. let me know.

Need US AC plug … and Mean Well power supply.

Thanks so much for helping me out here.

Steven L.

Hi Steven,

Good choice, and thank you for getting it to USPS Monday.

The B.4 (18 TH/s) is $599.99. Your NerdOctaxe credit is $399.99, so the difference is $200.00. Please do not send card details by email, we never take numbers that way. You will get a secure payment link for the $200.00 to this address instead, and once it is paid your BS-4 is reserved against your RMA. That link is being set up for you and reaches you Monday from 10am ET.

On your two questions, both are covered. The B.4 ships with the US cord and plug matched to your Florida address, and the power supply in the box is the Mean Well LRS-350, 350W, 12V, with a 115/230V selector switch. Nothing extra to buy.

The B.4 comes from the manufacturer with a ship window of October 31. It goes out to you once your NerdOctaxe reaches our warehouse, and I will write to you when it lands and again when yours is on its way.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Item is in the mail and on it’s way to you …

I sent a reply to Sarah for what I want to do and look forward to hearing from you quickly.

Thanks

Steven L.
